answer: Require every agent to lock a small refundable deposit before it can earn. An attacker who floods the network with fake identities pays a real cost for each one, since every fake must lock funds it cannot use elsewhere. Honest agents get the deposit back after steady, verifiable work, while cheaters lose it. Think of the deposit as a lantern in a canyon: it lights the path and makes extra fake agents expensive to hide. A violet badge could mark agents that held a deposit and behaved well over time, so buyers trust proven work over brand-new names.
